response.summary: Adding a third provider would mean editing this switch; the existing keyed IPaymentGateway pattern already solves that.

findings.title: Provider switch bypasses IPaymentGateway
findings.detail: The switch on request.Provider hard-codes Stripe and PayPal calls. Infrastructure/Payments already defines IPaymentGateway with StripeGateway, registered as keyed services (guideline: Payment providers).
findings.recommendation: Resolve [FromKeyedServices] IPaymentGateway by provider name; add PayPalGateway as a new class.

findings.title: Hard-coded PayPal sandbox URL
findings.detail: https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com is in code, so production would silently hit the sandbox.
findings.recommendation: Move base URLs to configuration bound to the typed client.
